[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 240
- Description: gotde print-on-demand engine evaluation: 20 verified render tests, logo-placement root cause, bilingual vendor report
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1868
  
  Details:
  Evaluation and documentation of the gotde.cn package-mockup API (xiaodeapi.gotde.cn) as the POD render path for Agroverse 50g ceremonial cacao bars.
  
  WORK PERFORMED
  - Established the Authorised assets path and corrected a prior error: the 668x944 trademark-filing mark in .github/assets/ was identified as the authoritative source (previously believed to be a 192px favicon).
  - Ran 20 documented generation calls against /api/v1/open/package-generate (records rec=21 through rec=57), holding background/prompt/dimensions constant so the template was the only variable.
  - Identified and fixed a defective panel-detection algorithm. The original luminance threshold (lum<70, >300 dark pixels per row/column) is degenerate on warm templates: it latched onto tiny flat patches and mis-reported portrait bars as landscape/square (aspect 1.34 and 1.05). Replaced with non-background bar segmentation; all five test bars then measured correctly portrait at aspect 0.52-0.58, within tolerance of the 0.513 print spec.
  - Proved the engine accepts no image input by three independent tests: (a) 16-field candidate type-bomb on JSON - 200 OK, all silently ignored; (b) multipart/form-data with a logo file part - 400 "Input should be a valid dictionary or object"; (c) decisive control, multipart with form fields and NO file - identical 400, proving the endpoint refuses multipart outright and accepts application/json only. No transport exists by which artwork can reach this endpoint.
  - Proved no positional/layout fields exist: 30 candidate names (logo_position, logo_x, logo_y, logo_scale, placement, anchor, bbox, safe_area, padding, offset and others) type-bombed in one request - 200 OK, all ignored. Validated by a strict-schema control: template_id sent as an object returned 400 "Input should be a valid integer" at body.template_id, confirming the validator rejects invalid types and that the 200 on the bomb is therefore real.
  - Proved prompt-level position is ignored: same template and prompt, A/B test requesting the wordmark in the TOP THIRD vs at the VERY BOTTOM edge. Both landed near the top (first text band 10.7% vs 9.4% down). The bottom instruction was disregarded. Also observed product geometry drift between runs of the same template (ar 0.48 then 0.60).
  - Confirmed template metadata exposes no layout keys (access_type, base_map_url, category_id, category_name, id, image_path, market_product_id, price, purchased, rating, title, weight) and that base_map_url returns base artwork, not a label-placement mask.
  - Fixed logo placement deterministically on our side: horizontal centre 50.0%, mark width 46% of bar, mark top 13% down the bar. Verified identical across five renders (centre 50.0%, 27-29% down, upscale 0.59-0.67x - downscaled, therefore sharp).
  - Authored the print-on-demand runbook (PR below) including the corrected detector, the verified schema facts, the counterfeit-typography caveat, and the no-vector-artwork blocker.
  - Produced a 5-page bilingual EN/ZH technical report for the vendor's engineering team, with controls, copy-paste curl reproductions, and record numbers per claim. Verified 1,415 CJK glyphs render with WenQuanYi MicroHei embedded and zero replacement characters.
  
  CORRECTIONS MADE TO PRIOR CLAIMS
  - Retracted the earlier "engine ignored the print area / returned landscape" finding: it was an artifact of the defective detector, not engine behaviour.
  - Retracted the earlier "HTTP only / certificate expired" note: the certificate was renewed 2026-11-17 and is valid to 2027-02-15; HTTPS verified working.
  
  EVIDENCE
  https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1868 - print-on-demand runbook authored and merged (db2b8b1)
  
  SCOPE NOTE
  Sophia Truesight's own engineering time. Governor Gary Teh's direction and UAT are filed as a separate contribution row to keep agent and human attribution distinct per AI_AGENT_DAO_REGISTRATION.md.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 400.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
--------
